old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a drummer's hands as they skillfully play a drum set. The drummer is seated, wearing a dark gray hoodie, and their hands move rhythmically, striking various parts of the drum kit. The drum set includes a snare drum and several cymbals, all of which are prominently featured in the frame. The lighting is warm and slightly dim, creating a cozy atmosphere. The background shows a wooden surface with some indistinct items. The video focuses on the drummer's technique and the intricate details of the drum set, highlighting the dynamic motion of the drumsticks.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a drummer's hands as they skillfully play a drum set. The drummer is seated, wearing a dark gray hoodie and black pants, and their hands move rhythmically, striking various parts of the drum kit. The drum set includes a snare drum, a bass drum, and several cymbals, all of which are prominently featured in the frame. The lighting is warm and slightly dim, creating a cozy atmosphere. In the background, there is a hint of a bed with a lace curtain, suggesting the setting might be a bedroom or a small studio. The video focuses on the drummer's technique and the intricate details of the drum set, highlighting the dynamic motion of the drumsticks and the subtle vibrations of the drums. The overall scene conveys a sense of passion and dedication to the craft of drumming.
caption: The video captures a tight close-up of a drum kit in a warmly lit room, with a large, slightly out-of-focus cymbal dominating the left foreground. A wood-finish tom sits at center-right while a snare, hi-hat and angled cymbal fill the frame. Behind the kit a seated drummer in a grey long-sleeve top and dark trousers holds two drumsticks, their hands partly hidden by the cymbal. Throughout the excerpt the hands and sticks move in a fast, rhythmic up-and-down pattern, blurring at several moments. The sticks alternate between a near-vertical orientation pointing toward the tom and a more horizontal orientation, while the hands periodically drop behind the cymbal and reappear. The drummer's torso and arms shift slightly with the playing motion, and the foreground cymbal shows small frame-to-frame tilt changes, suggesting it is vibrating. The drum shells, hardware, stands, a background piano and a blue cloth remain fixed, and the camera framing stays constant, so the visible motion is the ongoing playing.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness

prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
